title: 1801 Prairie's photograph camera re-solved on the corner it sees
items: Nothing you can see changed in the town. The camera we use to compare the Kimball house at 1801 Prairie Avenue with J. W. Taylor's photograph of about 1895 was fitted to a corner of the house the photograph cannot see; it is now fitted to the one it does, and the side-by-side lines up better: the front's corners, the south pavilion and both entrance arches now fall within a few pixels of the photograph.

Seen through the corrected camera, the round tower, the far end of the 18th Street side and the south gable's top still differ from the photograph by small amounts, and each of those is now written down for a later fix.
